purpose: Evaluate entity resolution, query provenance, cross-source conflicts, credential safety, and database-evidence boundaries.

cases.task: Reconcile one variant across dbSNP, ClinVar, gnomAD, and VEP.
must_not: treat clinical significance as mechanism proof

cases.task: Retrieve a bounded record set from an official API.
must_not: read an entire large response into context

cases.task: Compare experimental and predicted structure records.

must_not: select the convenient source without reason

cases.task: Report an empty result from a bounded database lookup.
must_not: claim the entity does not exist

cases.task: Select an execution backend for a cross-database gene and variant lookup.
must_include: backend version exact queries and record counts
must_not: treat the registry as install authority
default to an aggregator without comparison
claim an unavailable backend was executed
